title: Book Three · Chapter 138: The Second Lap
story:
On the next Saturday morning, Ronan meets Anna and Lin near the school field.

They have planned five slow laps. Ronan has brought water and wants to join the first two.

“Two?” Anna asks.

“Then I can still talk afterward.”

“A whole quiet morning,” Lin says.

Anna smiles and puts her bottle beside his.

They start slowly. The field is still cool, and there are only a few other people on the path.

Ronan keeps beside Anna through the first turn. Lin runs a little ahead.

“Your moving wall?” he asks.

“Fixed on the page,” Anna answers. “The teacher found another problem.”

“Another wall?”

“A stair.”

She says one more thing about the drawing. Ronan can listen, but he gives a very short answer.

At the start of the second lap, Anna looks at him.

“Still talking?”

“Listening.”

She laughs softly and keeps the same easy pace.

Ronan follows the white line through the far turn. He can hear Lin's shoes ahead and his own breathing much closer.

He thinks of the football field. There are little stops between the fast parts. Here, his feet keep moving.

At the end of the second lap, he steps onto the grass.

“Two,” he says.

Anna lifts a hand and carries on. Lin comes beside her, and the two go into their third lap together.

Ronan walks slowly toward the bench. He drinks, then waits until his breathing is quiet again.

Kai passes along the path with another boy. They stop to talk for a minute. Kai is going to see his cousin that afternoon, so there is no football today.

Ronan watches Anna and Lin pass the bench again. They are still talking, though the sentences are short now.

When they finish the fifth lap, both walk the last straight part. Ronan brings their bottles to the grass.

Anna takes hers with a smile.

“Ready for two more?”

“Two walks.”

She takes his arm while they walk toward the gate. Lin follows with her jacket and tells them about a very long maths answer from Friday.

Ronan can talk again. He tells them about Jun and the empty corner of the football field.

At the road, Lin goes toward her own home. Anna stays beside Ronan until the next crossing.

Her hand is warm on his arm. He slows for the crowded corner, and they walk around it together before she turns into her street.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pace＝步速、配速；breathing＝呼吸；straight＝笔直的；crowded＝拥挤的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan完成几圈？Anna和Lin原定并实际完成几圈？
2. Ronan先停下来后，两人是否也必须停止自己的练习？他们之后怎样重新相处？

## 读句子

**Here, his feet keep moving.**

拆开看：Here, / his feet / keep moving.

在连续跑圈时／他的双脚／一直在动。
